snippet.title: Frail Keep - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4854130/Frail_Keep/

Frail Keep is a first-person soulslike set in a world where an aged sorcerer put an end to humanity’s bloodshed by taking control of its will. For years, no one raised a sword. No one betrayed, rebelled, or started another war. The world became quiet and obeyed. Then his power began to fade. You awaken from the silence that held mankind still — haunted by visions of a distant keep.
